- Props: `name`*, `status`*, `bytes`, `compact`, `density`, `detail`, `direction`, `error`, `eta`, `ext`, `icon`, `id`, `now`, `onCancel`, `onOpen`, `onPause`, `onRemove`, `onResume`, `onRetry`, `progress`, `samples`, `speed`, `startedAt`, `total` (* required)

## TransferList

> Queue of transfers with a summary header ("3 active · 1 failed · 12.4 MB/s") and "Clear completed".

- Import: `import { TransferList } from "@sutra/ui/ops"` ([full page](md/TransferList.md))
- Props: `items`*, `compact`, `density`, `emptyMessage`, `emptyState`, `maxHeight`, `now`, `onCancel`, `onClearCompleted`, `onOpen`, `onPause`, `onRemove`, `onResume`, `onRetry`, `title` (* required)

**When to use:** A queue of uploads, downloads and background jobs: each row has a file icon, name, progress bar, bytes, speed, time left and a status, with per-row actions and a summary header ("3 active · 1 failed · 12.4 MB/s"). `TransferTray` is the floating, collapsible version pinned to a corner, and `TransferItem` is one row.

**Use instead when:**
- `FileUpload`: pick and validate files before they upload
- `Progress`: one bar
- `ProgressDialog`: a single blocking task in a modal
- `ProcessTable`: running processes with columns
- `ChatAttachment`: one attachment tile in a conversation
- `Toaster`: short notices

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Through each row's action buttons, then "Clear completed" (and, in the tray, the minimize and close buttons) |
| Enter, Space | Press the focused button: pause, resume, cancel, retry, open, remove, minimize, close |

Rows are not focusable themselves, and there are no arrow keys, so RTL changes nothing. The tray is not modal: it does not trap focus or react to Escape.

#### Screen readers

- The list is `role="list"` named by `title` (default "Transfers"); a row's status is spelled out as text ("In progress", "Paused", "Completed", "Failed", "Queued", "Canceled"), so it never depends on colour. Icons are `aria-hidden`; the direction badge is an image named "Upload", "Download", "Move" or "Process".
- A progress bar named "<name> progress" shows for active, paused and queued rows that have progress (indeterminate for an active row of unknown size). The percent, bytes, speed and "15s left" are plain text.
- A failed row with an `error` renders it in a `role="alert"`, so it is announced when it appears. Action buttons are named with the file ("Pause photos.zip", "Retry track.flac").
- The summary line is plain text, not a live region. `TransferTray` is a `region` labelled by its heading ("Uploading 3 items"); its toggle is "Minimize transfers" or "Expand transfers" with `aria-expanded`, and the body is `hidden` while minimized.

#### Reduced motion

The component has no motion of its own besides the progress fill's transition, which the global net ends within 1 ms.

#### Server rendering

Server render: part of it fills in after mount. Markup is computed from `items`. Speed and time left use `Date.now()` at render when they come from `startedAt` alone, so the server and client can differ by the time between them; give `speed` or `samples`, or pass `now`, to make it deterministic. The tray is fixed to the viewport unless `inline`.

#### Gotchas

- It moves no data and does not tick: you update `items` as bytes arrive and the display follows. Speed comes from `speed`, else the last five seconds of `samples`, else `startedAt` with `bytes`; ETA from the speed and the bytes left. A value derived from `startedAt` changes only when you re-render.
- A button appears only when the status allows it and you passed the handler: Pause (active), Resume (paused), Retry (failed, canceled), Open (completed), Cancel (queued, active, paused), Remove (completed, failed, canceled). List handlers receive the item `id`. "Clear completed" shows with `onClearCompleted` when completed or canceled rows exist (failed ones do not count).
- `status` also accepts `pending`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `canceled` and "cancelled"; `paused` has no TaskStatus equivalent. `progress` (0 to 100) wins over `bytes` and `total`, and a completed row always reads 100%.
- `TransferTray position` is physical (`bottom-right` or `bottom-left`) and does not mirror in RTL; `inline` renders it in the flow for previews, and `minimized` can be controlled with `onMinimizedChange`.

## TransferTray

> Floating, collapsible uploads/downloads panel pinned to a corner (Google Drive style).

- Import: `import { TransferTray } from "@sutra/ui/ops"` ([full page](md/TransferTray.md))
- Props: `items`*, `defaultMinimized`, `emptyMessage`, `emptyState`, `inline`, `maxHeight`, `minimized`, `now`, `onCancel`, `onClearCompleted`, `onClose`, `onMinimizedChange`, `onOpen`, `onPause`, `onRemove`, `onResume`, `onRetry`, `position`, `title` (* required)

## Treemap

> Squarified treemap: tiles sized by value, coloured by category, with hover/focus tooltips, arrow-key navigation, drill-down (Enter, click) and up (Backspace, Escape, breadcrumb), an optional legend and a screen-reader table.

- Import: `import { Treemap } from "@sutra/ui/dataviz"` ([full page](md/Treemap.md))
- Props: `data`*, `breadcrumb`, `colorFor`, `defaultPath`, `defaultWidth`, `depth`, `emptyState`, `gap`, `height`, `label`, `legend`, `loading`, `minLabelSize`, `onPathChange`, `onSelect`, `palette`, `path`, `tooltip`, `valueFormatter`, `valueLabel` (* required)

**When to use:** Tiles sized by value to compare many parts of a hierarchy at a glance (disk usage, bundle size, spend), with drill-down into groups, a tooltip and a screen-reader table. `StorageMap` wraps it for disks, with a used and free header and macOS, App data, Yours and Other categories.

**Use instead when:**
- `DonutChart`: a handful of parts of one whole
- `BarChart`: compare values on a common axis
- `BarList`: a ranked list with bars
- `BreakdownList`: a legend with values and shares
- `TreeView`: browse a hierarchy by name rather than by size

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | One tile holds the tab stop (the last active one); Tab then leaves the map |
| ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown | Move to the nearest tile in that direction on screen |
| Home, End | First or last tile |
| Enter, Space, click | Open a tile that has items inside; on a leaf it only fires `onSelect` |
| Backspace, Escape | Go up one level (only while drilled in); focus lands on the tile you came from |

The root is a forced `dir="ltr"` island and the arrows are spatial, so nothing swaps in RTL; the breadcrumb sits inside the island too.

#### Screen readers

- The map is a `group` with `aria-roledescription="treemap"`, named by `label` (default "Treemap") and described by a hidden hint on the arrow, Enter and Backspace keys.
- Each tile is a `button` named "Documents, 30, 30%, 3 items" (name, formatted value, share, child count); the visible text is `aria-hidden`, so tiles too small for a label are still named.
- A hidden table lists the tiles on screen (Name, `valueLabel`, Share) with the path as row header. The breadcrumb is a `navigation` named "<label> location" and a polite live region says "Showing Applications" after drilling. The tooltip is `aria-hidden`.
- With `loading` the root has `aria-busy` and one hidden "Loading <label>…".

#### Reduced motion

Only tile hover and dim use a 150 ms opacity and background transition, which the global net ends in 1 ms. Drilling swaps the tiles with no animation.

#### Server rendering

Server render: part of it fills in after mount. The layout needs the width: the server and the first client render lay the tiles out at `defaultWidth` (600 px), then the real width is measured after mount and the tiles are recomputed, so tile positions move on hydration. Values are formatted with `Intl` in the runtime locale unless you pass `valueFormatter`.

#### Slots

- `treemap`: the root; `treemap-map`: the tile area
- `treemap-tile`: one tile button (`data-id`, `data-depth`, `data-expanded`, `data-label` = `full`, `name` or `hidden`)
- `treemap-breadcrumb`, `treemap-tooltip`, `treemap-table`, `treemap-legend`: the other parts
- `treemap-skeleton`, `treemap-empty`: the loading and empty states
- `storage-map`: the `StorageMap` card; `storage-map-header`, `storage-map-used`, `storage-map-free`

#### Gotchas

- Size comes from `value`, or the sum of the children; zero, negative and non-finite values are not drawn, and when nothing has a size `emptyState` (default "No data") shows.
- `path` is the list of child ids from the root (the root's own id is not in it) and is controlled with `onPathChange`. `onSelect` runs on every tile activation, leaves included, before drilling.
- Backspace and Escape that go up also stop propagation, so Escape inside a Dialog first climbs a level, and closes the dialog only at the top. `depth` above 1 draws framed parents with a header (`StorageMap` uses 2).
- Colour is `colorFor`, then the node's `color`, then its top-level group's colour from `palette`; a prop `dir` on the root replaces the LTR island, as props are spread after it.

## TreeView

> Data-driven tree with expand/collapse, selection, tri-state checkboxes and full keyboard support.

- Import: `import { TreeView } from "@sutra/ui/navigation"` ([full page](md/TreeView.md))
- Props: `nodes`*, `checkable`, `checked`, `defaultChecked`, `defaultExpanded`, `defaultSelected`, `expanded`, `expandOnClick`, `indentGuides`, `onCheckedChange`, `onExpandedChange`, `onNodeAction`, `onSelectedChange`, `selected`, `selectionMode`, `showIcons`, `size`, `typeahead` (* required)

**When to use:** A data-driven tree of nodes you can expand, select (one, many or none) and optionally check with tri-state checkboxes, with the full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model, type-ahead and indent guides. Use it for file trees, nested settings and category pickers.

**Use instead when:**
- `Treemap`: hierarchy shown by size
- `Accordion`: a few stacked sections with free content
- `Sidebar`: app navigation
- `Select`: one value from a flat list
- `Table`: hierarchical rows with several columns

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | One tab stop (roving): the focused node, else the first selected visible node, else the first |
| ArrowDown, ArrowUp | Next or previous visible node. With Shift in `multiple` mode the destination is added to the selection |
| Arrow towards the inline end | On a closed parent: open it. On an open parent: focus its first child |
| Arrow towards the inline start | On an open parent: close it. Otherwise: focus the parent |
| Home, End | First or last visible node |
| Enter | Select the node (Ctrl or Cmd+Enter toggles in `multiple`) and call `onNodeAction` |
| Space | Toggle the checkbox when `checkable`, otherwise select (toggle in `multiple`) |
| `*` | Open every closed sibling of the focused node |
| Ctrl or Cmd+A | Select every enabled visible node (`multiple` only) |
| A letter | Jump to the next visible node whose text starts with what you typed (500 ms buffer; the same letter repeated cycles) |

In RTL the two horizontal arrows swap (`logicalArrow`): ArrowLeft opens and ArrowRight closes. Disabled nodes can be focused but not selected, opened or checked.

#### Screen readers

- The list is `role="tree"` and needs `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`; it has `aria-multiselectable` in `multiple` mode. Nodes are `treeitem`s with `aria-level`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-expanded` (parents only), `aria-selected` (not with `selectionMode="none"`), `aria-disabled`, and, when `checkable`, `aria-checked` including `mixed`. Child lists are `role="group"`.
- The chevron, the visual checkbox and the icons are `aria-hidden`: the state is on the item. Collapsed children are not in the DOM.
- Type-ahead reads `label` when it is a string or number; use `textValue` for any other label.

#### Reduced motion

The chevron turns with the `chevron-turn` transition and child lists open and close with `animate-collapsible-down` and `-up`. The global net ends the transition and the animation in 1 ms, so the list opens at once.

#### Server rendering

Server render: same markup as the client. The whole tree is plain markup from `nodes` and the expanded ids; only expanded branches are rendered. Nothing depends on browser APIs until a key is pressed (the direction is read then).

#### Gotchas

- A click on a row selects it and, on a parent, also toggles it (`expandOnClick`, default true). The chevron and the checkbox toggle only themselves. Parents are selectable too, and `onNodeAction` runs on click and Enter, not on Space or arrow movement.
- `expanded`, `selected` and `checked` are arrays of node ids with `onExpandedChange`, `onSelectedChange` and `onCheckedChange`. Checked state is derived from the leaves: `checked` lists every fully checked node, parents included, and a parent with a disabled unchecked leaf can only ever be `mixed` (toggling it checks the enabled leaves, toggling again clears them).
- `selectionMode` defaults to `single`; with `none` rows do not select (and omit `aria-selected`) but still expand and fire `onNodeAction`. With `checkable`, selection and checking are separate: Enter selects, Space checks.
- Row height is `size` (`sm` 28 px, `md` 32 px) and nesting indents by 14 or 16 px per level; `indentGuides={false}` and `showIcons={false}` remove the lines and the default folder and file icons.

## Typewriter

> Text that types itself (see `useTypewriter` for the timing options). Accessible: the current line is real text in a visually hidden span and the typed part and the caret are `aria-hidden`, so a screen reader reads the whole line once, never letter by letter, and the hidden text is there before the first character. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it prints the finished text straight away.

- Import: `import { Typewriter } from "@sutra/ui/motion"` ([full page](md/Typewriter.md))
- Props: `text`*, `as`, `cursor`, `delay`, `deleteSpeed`, `hold`, `loop`, `onDone`, `reserve`, `speed` (* required)

## Kits, blocks and assets

These are domain components; open `md/<Name>.md` for props and notes.

- `AccessGate` (`@sutra/ui/kunji`): Request-access flow for admin-approved apps: request → pending → approved (collect key) | denied.
- `AccessRequestQueue` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Pending pairing requests with approve / deny, plus approved users with confirm-to-revoke.
- `AccountPanel` (`@sutra/ui/identity`): Signed-in summary: avatar, name, role, app launch links, and sign out / sign out everywhere.
- `AcmeLogo` (`@sutra/ui/assets`): Acme — fictional placeholder logo.
- `ActivityFeed` (`@sutra/ui/security`): Alias of `SecurityActivityFeed`.
- `AgentAvatarBuilder` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Procedural agent avatar editor: shape, color, face, seeded generation and image upload, with a live preview.
- `AgentBrowserPane` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Agent-driven browser surface: address bar, lease banner, loading bar and an app-provided viewport.
- `AgentJobForm` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Create or edit a scheduled agent job: prompt or script, schedule, model, profile, skills, toolsets, repeat limit and delivery.
- `AgentMessageNotice` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Transcript row for an agent-to-agent message ("Messaged Researcher: …" / "Message from Planner") with an expandable payload.
- `AgentProcessCard` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): One agent session: logo, title, status pill, "agent · project · running 48 min", memory and the processes it started.
- `AgentProcessList` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Running agent sessions and the processes each one started, separated by rules; "Quit Session…" confirms first.
- `AgentRoom` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Multi-agent group chat: speaker-attributed transcript, round / turn indicator, hold state, mentions and typing indicators.
- `AgentRoster` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Pill that opens a popover panel listing subagents and background tasks. The ref goes to the pill.
- `AgentSessionList` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Sessions sidebar for agent apps: groups, search, status filter, multi-select, bulk actions and keyboard navigation.
- `AgentStatusDot` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Session status dot (a `StatusDot` preset): running and waiting pulse, elsewhere is a hollow ring.
- `AgentStatusLine` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Live agent activity above the composer: what the agent is doing (thinking, running a tool, waiting for permission or an answer) with…
- `AgentTodoList` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Read-only agent task list with progress header, status glyphs and a shimmering active item.
- `AlbumCard` (`@sutra/ui/media`): Square album art with a hover play FAB, title and subtitle.
- `AlertGroup` (`@sutra/ui/ops`): Collapsible grouped alert banner: severity summary, sorted list, per-item and bulk dismiss.
- `AlertRuleDialog` (`@sutra/ui/system`): `AlertRuleEditor` in a dialog; the draft resets every time it opens (the content unmounts when closed).
- `AlertRuleEditor` (`@sutra/ui/system`): Form to create or edit an alert rule: metric, comparator, threshold, window, scope, muted apps and a live preview.
- `AlertRuleList` (`@sutra/ui/system`): Alert rules with an on/off switch, the rule sentence, scope and muted apps, edit and delete; presets when empty.
- `AnnotationLayer` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Lets the user pin numbered comments on a page for the agent, then send them in one batch.
- `ApiKeyCreateDialog` (`@sutra/ui/security`): Create-key dialog: name, scopes, expiry and permissions, then a show-once secret.
- `ApiKeyList` (`@sutra/ui/security`): API keys table: masked key, scopes, expiry warnings, usage and a row menu (edit, rotate, revoke).
- `ApiKeyUsage` (`@sutra/ui/security`): Compact per-endpoint usage table with inline bars and error rate.
- `AppHeader` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): App top bar: sidebar trigger, breadcrumbs, ⌘K search palette, notifications and account menu.
- `AppLauncher` (`@sutra/ui/social`): Home-screen grid (or dock) of app tiles with arrow-key navigation, search, badges and a context menu slot.
- `ApprovalStack` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): A stacked queue of pending approvals: the top card is interactive, the rest peek out behind with a "+n more" count.
- `AppShell` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Complete app layout: SidebarProvider + AppSidebar + SidebarInset with AppHeader and content.
- `AppSidebar` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Full Sutra suite sidebar: workspace switcher, search, primary nav, apps, favorites, storage and account.
- `ArtifactCard` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Promoted artifact from a code fence or tool: kind, versions, streaming state, actions and a safe preview.
- `ArtifactKindIcon` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Icon for an artifact kind, in a tinted tile.
- `ArtifactLibrary` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Searchable grid / list of artifacts with kind filter chips and sorting.
- `ArtifactPreview` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Renders artifact content safely: code, markdown, SVG/image via `<img>`, HTML in a `sandbox=""` iframe.
- `ArtifactViewer` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Full artifact panel: Preview / Code tabs, version history and fullscreen.
- `AssistantOrb` (`@sutra/ui/voice`): The voice assistant's face: a radial glass orb or a layered waveform that shows what the assistant is doing (idle, listening, thinking,…
- `AttachmentThumbnails` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Data-driven row of `ChatAttachment`s: image tiles (click to preview in a Lightbox) and file cards with pages / size, upload progress,…
- `AudioLevelMeter` (`@sutra/ui/voice`): Bars that light up with an audio level (0..1). Horizontal bars stand up like an equalizer.
- `AuthCenteredPage` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Centered card on a dotted background, with the logo above and footer links below.
- `AuthImagePage` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Form on the left; full-bleed image or illustration slot on the right.
- `AuthMinimalPage` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): No card, no chrome: just the mark and the form, centered.
- `AuthorShelf` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Author header with a horizontally scrolling shelf of their extensions.
- `AuthProblem` (`@sutra/ui/kunji`): Full-panel auth error state with a plain explanation and recovery actions.
- `AuthSplitPage` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Two-column auth page: form on one side, brand panel with mesh gradient, testimonial and logos on the other.
- `AwaitingApproval` (`@sutra/ui/kunji`): "Waiting for an admin" screen that checks in the background and says so.
- `BackendHealthPill` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Health probe status (a live StatusBadge preset): checking spinner, healthy + latency, unreachable + reason, or not configured.
- `BackendPicker` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Execution backend radio cards with live health probes, re-check and configure actions.
- `BackgroundPattern` (`@sutra/ui/assets`): Absolutely positioned decorative pattern with a soft fade mask.
- `BackgroundTaskRow` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Background shell job: command, status, elapsed time, output tail and a kill action.
- `Backlinks` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): "Linked from N items" panel: backlinks grouped by app with highlighted context snippets.
- `BacklinkSnippet` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): Snippet with case-insensitive matches wrapped in <mark>.
- `BashToolBody` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Shell call body: `$ command` with copy, ANSI output, separate stderr and an exit code chip.
- `BeaconLogo` (`@sutra/ui/assets`): Beacon — fictional placeholder logo.
- `BillingBanner` (`@sutra/ui/billing`): Billing notice (trial ending, payment failed, over limit) with a CTA. A preset over `InlineAlert`.
- `BlueprintCard` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Automation template card: icon, title, description, schedule and tags; expands into a slot form that creates a job.
- `BlueprintGallery` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Filterable grid of automation templates (search + tag chips); one card expands at a time.
- `BookmarkButton` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Toggle that bookmarks a message.
- `BookmarksPane` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Pane listing bookmarked messages; click jumps to the message.
- `BranchPill` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Branch name chip: icon, head-truncated name, optional status dot and copy button.
- `BrowserConsole` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Collapsible page console with level toggles and a text filter.
- `CallQualityIndicator` (`@sutra/ui/social`): Four-bar connection quality indicator.
- `CallScreen` (`@sutra/ui/social`): In-call layout: remote video, draggable mirrored self-view, timer, quality and a control bar.
- `CapabilitiesShell` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Tabbed Skills / Toolsets / Connectors / Plugins hub with counts, search + sort and a responsive detail pane.
- `CapabilityDetailHeader` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Header of a capability detail pane: icon, title, provenance/trust badges and actions.
- `CapabilityMonogram` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Monogram tile used when a capability has no icon. A `Monogram` preset (brand gradient, card radius).
- `CardBrandMark` (`@sutra/ui/security`): Plain typographic brand mark (no logos).
- `CastDeviceList` (`@sutra/ui/media`): The device rows used inside `CastPicker` (usable on its own, e.g. in a settings page).
- `CastPicker` (`@sutra/ui/media`): Lists cast targets (TVs, phones, speakers…) with current-device marker and connecting/connected states.
- `CatalogCard` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Plugin/skill catalog entry with tier, trust, capabilities, platforms, stars and install/update states.
- `CenteredHeader` (`@sutra/ui/blocks`): Logo in the center, navigation split into left and right groups.
- `ChainOfThought` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Collapsible reasoning panel with a "Thinking… / Thought for Ns" header.
- `ChangedFilesCard` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Transcript card summarizing changed files ("N files changed +X −Y") with a Review action.
- `ChatAttachment` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): File attachment preview for prompts and messages: card, chip or image tile, with upload progress, failed / retry and preview.
- `ChatBranchSwitcher` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): "‹ 2/3 ›" pager for switching between response versions.

- `WorktreeDialog` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Create a git worktree: name, base branch picker (recent / local / remote), path preview and session switch.
- `WorldMap` (`@sutra/ui/geo`): Flat world map from bundled outlines (no network): a choropleth with a stepped legend, marker buttons (dots, icons or avatars, optionally…

## Hooks

- `useActiveIndicator` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Measures the active item of a tab strip / segmented control for a sliding indicator.
- `useAgentNow` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Current time, re-rendered every `interval` ms while `active`.
- `useAssistantOrbState` (`@sutra/ui/voice`): The orb state for what a voice session is doing, by priority: error, speaking, thinking, listening, muted, idle.
- `useAsyncAction` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Tracks a possibly-async action: `busy`, `error`, and a stable `run`.
- `useAudioLevel` (`@sutra/ui/voice`): Live RMS input level (0..1) of a MediaStream, sampled each animation frame. Returns 0 without a stream.
- `useBreakpoint` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): True when the viewport is at least the named breakpoint's width (`min-width`, from the tokens).
- `useCamera` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Opens a camera with getUserMedia and tracks permission and errors.
- `useCaretAnchor` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Position a fixed popup under (or above) the caret of a field, re-measured on scroll/resize.
- `useChatConversation` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Access the enclosing ChatConversation's scroll state.
- `useChatMessage` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Read the enclosing message's role, variant and streaming state.
- `useCommandMenuShortcut` (`@sutra/ui/overlays`): Toggles a command menu with ⌘/Ctrl + `key` (default "k"). Registers in the shortcut registry when a `ShortcutProvider` is present;…
- `useComposerHistory` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Shell-style prompt history for composers: ↑/↓ recall previous prompts when the caret is at the start / end.
- `useConfirm` (`@sutra/ui/overlays`): Shortcut for `useDialogs().confirm`.
- `useControllableState` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): State that can be controlled (value + onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue).
- `useCopy` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Copy text to the clipboard; `copied` flips true for `timeout` ms.
- `useCountdown` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Time left until `deadline`, recomputed from the wall clock on every tick (no drift).
- `useDebouncedValue` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): A copy of `value` that follows it after it has stopped changing for `delay` ms (default 300).
- `useDialogs` (`@sutra/ui/overlays`): Promise-based `confirm`, `prompt` and `choose` (`if (!(await confirm("Delete?"))) return;`).
- `useDirection` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): The reading direction components should assume: the nearest `DirectionProvider` with a `dir`, else the `dir` of the document (`<html dir>`,…
- `useDirectoryPickerSupport` (`@sutra/ui/forms`): `supportsDirectoryPicker()` as a hook: `false` on the server and during hydration, then the real answer.
- `useDisclosure` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Open/close state for any overlay or disclosure, controlled or uncontrolled, with stable handlers.
- `useDrag` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Tracks a pointer drag: the offset follows the finger through CSS variables (no React state per move), with an axis lock, bounds with…
- `useElementSize` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Border-box size of an element, updated on resize (`{0, 0}` until measured).
- `useElementWidth` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Border-box width of an element, updated on resize (0 until measured).
- `useEmbedConsent` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Read remembered embed consent (null outside an EmbedConsentProvider).
- `useField` (`@sutra/ui/forms`): Wires a form control to the nearest `Field`: id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, disabled and required.
- `useFieldContext` (`@sutra/ui/forms`): Read the surrounding field context, or `null` outside a `Field`.
- `useFileUpload` (`@sutra/ui/forms`): Access the nearest `FileUpload` state (files, add/remove, picker).
- `useFlip` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): FLIP for a list: pass the ordered keys and put `register(key)` on each element.
- `useFocusView` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Read the focus-view state. Returns an inert "not focused" value outside a provider.
- `useHasShortcutProvider` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): True when rendered inside a `ShortcutProvider`.
- `useHasTooltipProvider` (`@sutra/ui/overlays`): True when rendered inside a `TooltipProvider`.
- `useInstallPrompt` (`@sutra/ui/social`): Captures `beforeinstallprompt` and tracks whether the PWA is installed.
- `useIsoLayoutEffect` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): `useLayoutEffect` in the browser, `useEffect` on the server (no SSR warning).
- `useKunjiSignIn` (`@sutra/ui/kunji`): State machine for kunji sign-in: idle → loading → ready → scanned → success | expired | denied | notLinked | error.
- `useLatestRef` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): A ref that always holds the latest value (updated before effects run), for stable callbacks.
- `useLightbox` (`@sutra/ui/mobile`): Imperative control for a `Lightbox`: `const lb = useLightbox(); lb.openAt(2); <Lightbox items={…} {...lb.props} />`.
- `useMarqueeSelection` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Rubber-band selection: drag on empty space inside `containerRef` to draw a rectangle and select the items it touches.
- `useMediaElement` (`@sutra/ui/media`): Subscribes to an `HTMLMediaElement` (or any `MediaElementLike`) and exposes its state plus imperative actions.
- `useMediaPortalContainer` (`@sutra/ui/media`): The element media menus portal into, or null for `document.body`.
- `useMediaQuery` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Whether a CSS media query matches, kept in sync (SSR-safe via `useSyncExternalStore`).
- `useMergedRefs` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): `mergeRefs` with a stable identity while the refs themselves don't change (avoids ref churn on every render).
- `useMountedRef` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): A ref that is true while mounted: set on (re)mount, false after unmount (StrictMode-safe).
- `useNoticeQueue` (`@sutra/ui/workspace`): Queue state for `RotatingNoticeBar`: dedupe by id, priority sort and a dismissed set.
- `useNow` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Current time in epoch ms, re-rendering every `interval` ms while `active` (or the `fixed` time).
- `useObjectUrl` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): An object URL for a Blob or File, revoked when the source changes or the component unmounts.
- `useObjectUrlState` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): An object URL for a Blob or File plus a pending flag. The URL is created in an effect (StrictMode-safe), revoked when the source changes or…
- `useOnlineStatus` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): Tracks `navigator.onLine` with online/offline events. Renders `true` on the server and during hydration.
- `usePagination` (`@sutra/ui/navigation`): Memoized pagination range helper.
- `usePan` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Drag with inertia: a release keeps its velocity and slows down with time-based friction; past the bounds it springs back.
- `usePlayerQueue` (`@sutra/ui/media`): Queue state for a player: current item, play order and next/previous with repeat & shuffle semantics.
- `usePointerVars` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Publishes the pointer over an element as CSS variables, for the `spotlight`, `tilt` and `magnetic` utilities.
- `usePrefersReducedMotion` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Live reduced-motion preference: `<html data-motion="reduce" | "full">` wins over `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- `usePresence` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Keeps removed items for a moment (state `"exit"`) so they can animate out, and marks new ones `"enter"`.
- `usePrevious` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): The last value that `value` had before its current one (`undefined`, or `initial`, until it first changes).
- `usePromptInput` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Access the enclosing PromptInput state.
- `useRegistryCommands` (`@sutra/ui/overlays`): Registry shortcuts as runnable commands, grouped. Empty outside a `ShortcutProvider`.
- `useReorder` (`@sutra/ui/social`): Controlled/uncontrolled list state with move helpers.
- `useResizeObserver` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Calls `callback` whenever the element resizes (no-op where `ResizeObserver` is missing).
- `useRollingSeries` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): A fixed-size buffer of the most recent values, for live charts. When `T` is itself an array, wrap single values: `push([value])`.
- `useRootDirection` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): For wrappers of Radix roots, which always write a `dir` attribute (ltr when told nothing): the direction in effect where the root sits,…
- `useSafeId` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Stable unique id containing only `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, safe in SVG `url(#id)`, CSS selectors and `href="#id"`.
- `useSampler` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Calls `read` every `interval` ms and keeps the last `capacity` results, for live charts.
- `useScheduleNow` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Re-render every `intervalMs` while `enabled`; returns the current timestamp.
- `useScrollEdges` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Scroll-edge detection for fades and prev/next buttons; updates on scroll and on resize of the container or its content.
- `useScrollProgress` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): The script fallback of the scroll-driven utilities. In browsers with `animation-timeline` the CSS does everything and this hook does…
- `useScrollSections` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Scroll-spy for a list of sections: tracks which element is in view with one `IntersectionObserver`, and scrolls to one on request…
- `useSelectionArea` (`@sutra/ui`): Selection state and item props from the nearest `SelectionArea`.
- `useShortcut` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): Bind `keys` to `handler`. Pass `null` keys (or `enabled: false`) to disable.
- `useShortcutManager` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): The nearest `ShortcutManager`, or null outside a `ShortcutProvider`.
- `useShortcutPlatform` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): Platform used for `mod` and glyphs: the `platform` given to the `ShortcutProvider`, else detected.
- `useShortcutRegistry` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): All labelled, non-hidden shortcuts in the registry, grouped. Deduplicated by id (latest wins).
- `useShortcuts` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): Register several shortcuts at once. Works standalone (local listener) without a provider.
- `useShortcutScope` (`@sutra/ui/suite`): Push a named scope while mounted so its shortcuts shadow lower scopes.
- `useSidebar` (`@sutra/ui/navigation`): Access sidebar state. Must be used inside `SidebarProvider`.
- `useSlashTrigger` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Watch a textarea for a trigger character at the start of a word and report the query under the caret.
- `useSlotContributions` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Contributions for one slot, re-rendering when the registry changes.
- `useSlotRegistry` (`@sutra/ui/agent-admin`): Access the nearest slot registry (`register`, `unregister`, `get`). Throws outside a `SlotProvider`.
- `useSpeechRecognition` (`@sutra/ui/voice`): Web Speech API wrapper with interim/final transcript; inert (supported=false) where unavailable.
- `useSpeechSynthesis` (`@sutra/ui/voice`): speechSynthesis wrapper: voices (async-loaded), voice for `lang`, speaking state, speak/cancel.
- `useSpringValue` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): A number that springs toward `target` for values CSS cannot animate (a count-up, a gauge angle, a value fed to a canvas).
- `useStagger` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): `stagger` with a fixed `step` (ms), as a stable function for a list: `const at = useStagger(20); style={at(i)}`.
- `useStickToBottom` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Keep a scroller pinned to the bottom while content grows, until the user scrolls up.
- `useStopwatch` (`@sutra/ui/social`): Stopwatch state: elapsed ms, running flag, laps and start / pause / lap / reset actions.
- `useStreamingTask` (`@sutra/ui/ops`): Consume an async iterator or EventSource-like emitter of `{ progress, phase, log }` events into state.
- `useSwipe` (`@sutra/ui/mobile`): Detects a flick (decided when the pointer lifts, so it never fights native scrolling).
- `useSwipeDismiss` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Drag along one axis and let go: past the distance (or fast enough) it dismisses, otherwise it springs back.
- `useTextareaMirror` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): Keeps a mirror element laid out exactly like a textarea (font, padding, borders, wrapping, scrollbar gutter, size and scroll offset) so…
- `useTheme` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Read and write Sutra theme attributes on <html>. `initial` seeds the state on mount only (like `useState`); fields it leaves out are read…
- `useThinkingExpandAll` (`@sutra/ui/ai`): The nearest ThinkingExpandAllProvider state, or null outside one.
- `useTranscriptBookmarks` (`@sutra/ui/agent`): Bookmark state helper: list, membership and toggle.
- `useTypewriter` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Types one line, or several in turn, one character at a time (graphemes are not split).
- `useViewTransition` (`@sutra/ui/tokens`): Returns `(update, options?) => Promise<void>` that applies a state change as a view transition: the browser snapshots the page, React…
- `useVirtualRows` (`@sutra/ui/ops`): Fixed-height windowing: which rows of a long list are inside (or near) the viewport.
- `useZoomPan` (`@sutra/ui`): Zoom/pan state + handlers: wheel and pinch zoom around the pointer, drag to pan, double-click reset, keyboard +/−/0/arrows.
